classification.difficultyReason: Coordinate three adjoining pair sums to determine and check three unknown integers in each puzzle.

content.prompt: The integers on the edges of each triangle below are the sums of the integers in the adjoining two circles. Find the numbers in the circles.

spec.description: Three writable white vertex circles joined in an upright triangle; edge labels remain outside their corresponding edges.
spec.mathematics: Top plus left equals -4; top plus right equals -2; left plus right equals -6.
spec.answerVisibility: All three vertex circles are empty in the question.

answer.worked:
Try $0$ in the top circle. The left and right sums then require $-4$ and $-2$ in the bottom circles. All three edges check:
$$\begin{align*}0+(-4)&=-4\\0+(-2)&=-2\\-4+(-2)&=-6\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three writable white vertex circles joined in an upright triangle, with exterior edge sums.
spec.mathematics: Top plus left equals -3; top plus right equals -5; left plus right equals -8.
spec.answerVisibility: All three vertex circles are empty in the question.

answer.worked:
Try $0$ in the top circle. The left and right sums then require $-3$ and $-5$ in the bottom circles. All three edges check:
$$\begin{align*}0+(-3)&=-3\\0+(-5)&=-5\\-3+(-5)&=-8\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three writable white vertex circles joined in an upright triangle, with exterior edge sums.
spec.mathematics: Top plus left equals 10; top plus right equals -6; left plus right equals -24.
spec.answerVisibility: All three vertex circles are empty in the question.

answer.worked:
The bottom-right number is $16$ less than the bottom-left number, because the right edge sum is $16$ less than the left edge sum. Two equal bottom numbers would each be $-12$. Increasing one by $8$ and decreasing the other by $8$ gives $-4$ and $-20$, which still sum to $-24$. The top number is $14$. Check:
$$\begin{align*}14+(-4)&=10\\14+(-20)&=-6\\-4+(-20)&=-24\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three writable white vertex circles joined in an upright triangle, with exterior edge sums.
spec.mathematics: Top plus left equals -12; top plus right equals -24; left plus right equals -16.
spec.answerVisibility: All three vertex circles are empty in the question.

answer.worked:
The bottom-right number is $12$ less than the bottom-left number. Two equal bottom numbers would each be $-8$. Increasing one by $6$ and decreasing the other by $6$ gives $-2$ and $-14$, which still sum to $-16$. The top number is $-10$. Check:
$$\begin{align*}-10+(-2)&=-12\\-10+(-14)&=-24\\-2+(-14)&=-16\end{align*}$$
